cues: A lone pair on chlorine overlaps with the ring's pi system and spreads into it, putting negative charge on the ortho and para carbons.
So the carbon chlorine bond gains partial double bond character.
It shrinks from one seventy seven picometres in chloromethane to one sixty nine in chlorobenzene, and becomes much harder to break.
text: Reason one, resonance. A lone pair on chlorine overlaps with the ring's pi system and spreads into it, putting negative charge on the ortho and para carbons. So the carbon chlorine bond gains partial double bond character. It shrinks from one seventy seven picometres in chloromethane to one sixty nine in chlorobenzene, and becomes much harder to break.
